incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: INC-94021 — embeddings-consumers: high queue depth / increased latency (P2) • region: eu-west-1 • https://pagerduty.example/incidents/INC-94021

pagerduty: Incident INC-94021 triggered by alert 'queue_depth > 10k for 5m'

Jordan (oncall): Oncall Jordan here. Claiming INC-94021. Jumping in — will do quick triage.

Sofia (sre): Acked in PD and Slack. I'm with Jordan, will look at consumer autoscaler + metrics.

Priya (eng): Grafana shows queue depth ~18.7k for embeddings-consumers, consumer pods=3 (HPA target 10). Looks like HPA not scaling; metric rpc rate is flat.

Jordan (oncall): Running quick log check on one consumer pod, tailing logs:
```
2026-03-14T18:10:13Z ERROR consumer: Failed to poll shard: iterator expired
2026-03-14T18:10:14Z WARN  backoff: retrying in 2s
2026-03-14T18:11:01Z ERROR consumer: GetRecords error: ProvisionedThroughputExceededException
```

Priya (eng): That `iterator expired` + throughput errors means the ingestion stream had a hotspot and some iterators stalled. HPA metric exporter might have dropped the kinesis_records_processed metric.

Lee (ops): Manual scale up to 8 replicas to catch up. Command run: `kubectl scale deployment embeddings-consumers --replicas=8 --namespace=prod-eu`

incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC-94021 acknowledged by Jordan.

Mikey (support): Customer-impact: support queue shows 4 cases reporting 500/503 from embedding endpoints in EU. CS alerted, posting customer-facing status. No widespread outage yet but some customers impacted.

Sofia (sre): After scale -> queue depth dropped to ~9.2k, RPS for consumers increased but per-request latency still elevated (~1.1s). Autoscaler logs show metrics exporter N/A for last 10m.

Priya (eng): I'm deploying a small metrics-exporter patch (v1.2.1-hotfix) to restore the HPA metric emission. Rolling out to prod-eu now.

Jordan (oncall): Quick mitigation plan: 1) scale consumers to 8 (done), 2) patch metrics exporter (Priya), 3) enable regional-fallback for eligible customers to us-west-2 (Priya) to reduce incoming pressure if needed.

Priya (eng): Enabling regional-fallback for low-risk tenant group: `featureflag --enable regional-fallback --env prod --region eu` (note: only for tenants who opted-in).

Jordan (oncall): Heads-up — I need to step away in ~20m. Handing off ownership to Lee unless objections. Lee, can you own for the next hour?

Lee (ops): Taking over. I'll check HPA, GC pauses, and continue monitoring queue depth every 10m. Ping me for any regressions.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC-94021 reassigned to Lee.

Lee (ops): Current diagnostics: `kubectl describe hpa embeddings-consumers` shows HPA target metric 'kinesis_records_processed' absent (0 samples). Suspect metrics-exporter bug. Also seeing occasional long GC pauses in consumer logs.

Priya (eng): Patch deployed. Metrics exporter restarted on prod-eu; new metrics visible in Prometheus: `kinesis_records_processed` returning sane values. Also bumped liveness threshold to reduce GC impact.

Mikey (support): Customer update posted to CS and incident channel: "We're aware of increased embedding latency in EU; mitigation underway; routing and scale applied. Will update in 30m."

Lee (ops): Queue depth trending down — 2.3k now. Error rate for embedding endpoint dropped from 3.1% -> 0.4%. Marking this as partial mitigation. Will continue monitoring for 30m, then propose PD close if stable.

Jordan (oncall): Thanks everyone. If no regressions in 30m, we can close PD and file a brief postmortem to cover HPA metric hardening + failover playbook. :thumbsup:

Mikey (support): Noted. I'll await final signoff before sending final customer update.

Lee (ops): Will update again in 20m with final status.

[end of thread]
